name: OmaConnect
description: KDE Connect in the bar and a panel: pairing, battery and signal, ring, clipboard, files, text, ping, SMS, the phone's media player, remote commands, and Tailscale or saved addresses for devices discovery misses (haseen kdeconnect). Adapted from jitendradara12's OmaConnect (MIT). Off by default

showBatteryStats.description: Battery percentage and charging state in the panel

showBarBattery.description: Battery percentage next to the glyph in the bar

showNetworkStats.description: Cellular network type and signal strength

showTailscale.description: The Network section: Tailscale peers and saved addresses

showDeviceTypeIcons.description: A glyph per device type (phone, tablet, laptop) instead of a phone for all

showRemoteCommands.description: Commands set up on the device (Run command)

showTroubleshooting.description: Firewall and KDE Connect app buttons while no device is reachable

showActionText.description: Send text or a link button

defaultPingMessage.description: Text a ping carries when the field is empty

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.omaconnect (state, refresh, call) from the service
